newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Paraguay wants steelworks privatized by Oct 21.
newsitem.headline: Paraguay wants steelworks privatized by Oct 21.

text.p: The Paraguayan government Monday announced it will privatize the Aceros Paraguayos (Acepar) steelworks, hopefully by October 21.
The base price for the sale has been set at $35 million, following a recommendation by Banque Paribas in 1995.
"We hope that the process of privatizating Acepar will be finished by October 21," Atilio Fernandez, director of the government's privatization council, told a news conference.
But the sale is opposed by Acepar's workers, who have offered to buy the plant and invest $60 million over five years, in association with suppliers.

Acepar was built in the 1970s during the rule of former strongman General Alfredo Stroessner at a cost of $105 million. The plant, which at one stage produced 150,000 tonnes of steel in a year, made money until 1994 but lost $10.4 million in 1995.
